intro.heading: About Karma TV
intro.body: Karma TV (කර්ම රූපවාහිනී) is a Sri Lankan television channel dedicated to Buddhist teachings and holistic wellness. Broadcasting on SLT PEO TV Channel 113, Karma TV brings viewers a comprehensive range of programs covering Buddha Dhamma, health counselling, yoga, Ayurveda, Feng Shui and Yantra sciences.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: Our core mission is to spread the noble teachings of the Buddha through modern technology and preserve Sri Lanka's traditional wisdom heritage. Through Dharma sermons, meditation guidance, health counselling and holistic wellness programs, we aim to enlighten and enrich the lives of our viewers.

peoTv.heading: PEO TV Channel 113
peoTv.body: Karma TV broadcasts as Channel 113 on SLT's PEO TV IPTV platform. PEO TV subscribers can tune into Karma TV at any time to access our full range of programming.
